verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers YubiKey's general FIDO2/WebAuthn/passkey protocol support and a fleet-management API (YubiEnterprise) for shipment/inventory, but contains no mention of specific IdP integrations (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace) or of admin-configurable policies enforcing hardware-key-only authentication. Since IdP integration and policy enforcement are a fair and expected axis for an enterprise MFA hardware vendor, absence of evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'. Missing for 10: documented Okta/Entra ID/Google Workspace integration guides, admin policy/enforcement console features, and any independent confirmation these integrations work in practice.
